obligations.title: Transparency to users (AI system interaction)
obligations.requirement: Provide clear information to users that they are interacting with an AI system when applicable.
obligations.applies_if: AI systems interacting directly with natural persons where required by the Act.

obligations.title: Data governance and data quality (high-risk)
obligations.requirement: Define data governance measures for training/validation/testing datasets (quality, relevance, representativeness).
obligations.applies_if: High-risk AI systems as defined by the Act.

obligations.title: Logging / record-keeping for high-risk AI
obligations.requirement: Enable automatic event logging and keep logs to support traceability and compliance.
obligations.applies_if: High-risk AI systems; where logging obligations apply.

obligations.title: Human oversight for high-risk AI
obligations.requirement: Provide measures enabling effective human oversight throughout operation.

obligations.title: Accuracy, robustness, cybersecurity
obligations.requirement: Design and develop systems to achieve accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity appropriate to risk.
obligations.applies_if: High-risk AI systems (and generally risk-based obligations).

obligations.title: APP transparency and privacy notice
obligations.requirement: Maintain an up-to-date privacy policy and provide notice of collection and use of personal information.
obligations.applies_if: Personal information is collected/processed (including via vendors).

obligations.title: Notifiable Data Breaches (NDB) incident notification
obligations.requirement: Ensure processes to assess and notify eligible data breaches as required under NDB scheme.
obligations.applies_if: Personal information breach likely to result in serious harm.

obligations.title: Baseline security controls (Essential Eight)
obligations.requirement: Implement baseline security controls (patching, MFA, backups, application control) proportional to risk.
obligations.applies_if: Systems handling sensitive data or providing critical services.
